messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] readModels skipped R-SQUARE?
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

FYI, I just implemented one of the more popular feature requests: R-SQUARE output extraction. I've tested it on several output files and it seems to work properly. Hope this proves useful to others. You can obtain this feature by installing the development version of the package from Github: https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation.

Best,
Michael

messages.subject: Error in all Mplus commands
messages.body_plain:
Dear all

I have been using MplusAutomation for a while with no problems (and great satisfaction!).

Today I have instaleld it on a new machine in the office (Windows 8, running R version 3.2 and Rstudio 0.99.441) and very time a try to run MplusAutomation commands (runModels, ReadModels, etc..) I get the same error:

"4 arguments passed to .Internal(nchar) which requires 3"

The same commands work fine in my other machines.

Any suggestion?

Thanks you

Annibale

messages.subject: Re: Error in all Mplus commands
messages.body_plain:
Hi Annibale,

This looks like a more serious error in R that doesn't pertain to MplusAutomation per se. Do you get similar errors with other packages? I would try reinstalling R and MplusAutomation from scratch if the problem below doesn't clear up. The package calls nchar in a few places, but only uses one parameter, and doesn't use the internal call directly.

Best,
Michael
